# Art list

Every image the game can use. Format, anchors and layouts: **ART_SPEC.md**. Priority: core = the game looks unfinished without it; nice = small polish; optional = the game already makes a good stand-in (tinted generic gear, tinted theme tiles, particle effects); not needed = never shown. Add each finished file to `assets/assets.js`.

**2230 files, 0 hand-made so far.** Generated by `tests/assets.html` from the game code on 2026-10-15 — do not edit by hand; re-run the page.
